completed_epochs_detail: 1 original + 2 resumed (identical config, continued from epoch-1 weights)
optimizer_state: not saved (checkpoint stores model weights only); training is frozen
best_vs_final: only the final-epoch checkpoint was persisted; GEARS's in-memory best-val model was not saved separately - final checkpoint is NOT labeled as best
architecture: GEARS_Model: gene_emb/pert_emb/emb_pos (64d) + SGConv co-expression GNN (num_gene_gnn_layers) + SGConv GO GNN (num_go_gnn_layers) + cross-gene MLP decoder with per-gene weights
loss: GEARS loss_fct: MSE on pred vs y + direction penalty (direction_lambda), computed on train genes only (dict_filter); pred = decoder(...) + basal x[:,0]
output_scale: log1p-normalized expression (same scale as h5ad X); NOT raw counts; delta outputs are differences of log1p values, not log-fold-changes

seeds.training_seed: no explicit global seed set during training

dataset: Replogle 2022 K562 gwps, Figshare+ doi:10.25452/figshare.plus.20029387; 10 cells/pert subsample + 2000 ctrl = 78,190 cells; 8,248-gene HVG panel

splits.regimes: unseen_single only (test genes have zero overlap with train genes)

graph_construction.go_csv: go.csv (top-21 neighbors per gene retained by GEARS)

determinism_check.interpretation: predictions are STOCHASTIC by design: GEARS predict() resamples 300 control cells per condition as basal (np.random.randint in create_cell_graph_dataset_for_prediction, gears/utils.py:283). Re-prediction of the same condition with a different control draw differs by up to ~0.3-0.4 log1p units on the worst genes (max abs diff over 5 val conditions: 0.377). Stored test/val predictions are single draws; averaging multiple draws or using the full 2,000-cell control mean as basal would reduce this noise floor.
determinism_check.note: re-prediction vs stored validation_predictions.npz, same checkpoint, eval mode
determinism_check.root_cause: control-cell resampling in GEARS predict() (gears/utils.py:283), not float nondeterminism
